forbidden_action: Treat foot values as meters without conversion
required_instead: Convert with factor 0.3048 then set unit=meter

forbidden_action: Treat Kelvin values as Celsius without conversion
required_instead: Convert with offset K-273.15 then set unit=degree_celsius
notes: Ocean products in this repo default to Celsius

forbidden_action: Treat Atlantic RVC NUM real-valued average as integer fish count
required_instead: Keep unit=real_valued_average; do not cast to int fish count
notes: Documented in ATLANTIC_ZERO_SEMANTICS.md; NUM is not an integer count of fish

forbidden_action: Treat a raw count as areal density
required_instead: Require documented area denominator and density unit
Keep quantity=cpue unless effort expansion is documented
notes: CPUE is a rate not a stock size

notes: MUR SST is surface-only; bottom temperature not acquired as substitute

forbidden_action: Invent hour or finer timestamp for date-only records
required_instead: Keep time_precision=DAY and omit invented clock time
notes: Aligns with temporal integrity date-only rule
